summary: This directory serves as the root entry point for the JSDoc automation system, orchestrating the integration of path utilities, project state snapshots, and documentation update workflows to provide a cohesive toolset for maintaining project-wide code documentation.
responsibilities: Expose unified access to core JSDoc maintenance operations
Integrate file system path utilities with documentation processing logic
Orchestrate the interaction between snapshot-based change tracking and document update cycles
Provide public APIs for managing source file documentation lifecycle
relationships: The root entry point exposes functionality from child modules to provide a unified API surface.
Documentation update workflows leverage path utilities and snapshot metadata to identify and apply changes to the correct target files.
Integrated modules share common configuration and identity mappings to ensure consistency across the documentation lifecycle.
designDecisions: Consolidation of distinct subsystems into a single package export interface
Composition of discrete functional modules to build the overall documentation pipeline
Centralized namespace management for external-facing APIs
